// SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
// Test tables: Copyright Grafana Labs contributors.
// Adapted for Pulse on 2026-10-27; see LICENSE and README.md.
// Extracts original test inputs/expectations, without evaluating LogQL.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func number(s string) int             { n, err := strconv.Atoi(s); must(err); return n }
func unquote(s string) string         { v, err := strconv.Unquote(s); must(err); return v }
func literal(e ast.Expr) string       { return unquote(e.(*ast.BasicLit).Value) }
func emit(enc *json.Encoder, row any) { must(enc.Encode(row)) }

type check struct {
	Line  string `json:"line"`
	Match bool   `json:"match"`
}
type load struct {
	App   string `json:"app"`
	Line  string `json:"line"`
	Start int    `json:"start"`
	Every int    `json:"every"`
	Count int    `json:"count"`
}
type series struct {
	Labels map[string]string `json:"labels"`
	Values []string          `json:"values"`
}
type engineCase struct {
	Kind        string   `json:"kind"`
	Fixture     int      `json:"fixture"`
	Loads       []load   `json:"loads"`
	Query       string   `json:"query"`
	Instant     bool     `json:"instant"`
	Start       int      `json:"start"`
	End         int      `json:"end"`
	Step        int      `json:"step"`
	Expected    []series `json:"expected"`
	Reject      string   `json:"reject,omitempty"`
	SourceStart int      `json:"source_start"`
	SourceEnd   int      `json:"source_end"`
}

func main() {
	enc := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fset, os.Args[1], nil, 0)
	must(err)
	tables, decisions := 0, 0
	ast.Inspect(f, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		item, ok := n.(*ast.CompositeLit)
		if !ok || len(item.Elts) != 3 {
			return true
		}
		start, end := fset.Position(item.Pos()).Line, fset.Position(item.End()).Line
		if start < 400 || end > 589 {
			return true
		}
		q, ok := item.Elts[0].(*ast.BasicLit)
		if !ok || q.Kind != token.STRING {
			return true
		}
		query := literal(q)
		if !strings.Contains(query, " or ") {
			panic("unexpected selected query")
		}
		checks := []check{}
		for _, entry := range item.Elts[2].(*ast.CompositeLit).Elts {
			pair := entry.(*ast.CompositeLit)
			checks = append(checks, check{literal(pair.Elts[0]), pair.Elts[1].(*ast.Ident).Name == "true"})
		}
		emit(enc, map[string]any{"kind": "table", "query": query, "checks": checks, "source_start": start, "source_end": end})
		tables++
		decisions += len(checks)
		return false
	})
	if tables != 27 {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("unexpected table count: %d", tables))
	}

	// This is deliberately a reader for the two selected fixture sections,
	// not a general .logqltest parser. Unsupported source shapes fail closed.
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[2])
	must(err)
	lines := strings.Split(string(data), "\n")
	loadRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\s*\{app="([^"]+)"\}\s+("(?:[^"\\]|\\.)*")\s+@ (\d+)s(?: \[repeat every (\d+)s for (\d+)\])?$`)
	instantRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval instant at (\d+)s (.+)$`)
	rangeRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^eval range from (\d+)s to (\d+)s step (\d+)s (.+)$`)
	resultRE := regexp.MustCompile(`^\s*(\{(?:app="([^"]+)")?\})\s+([\d_ ]+)$`)
	fixture, evaluations := 0, 0
	var loads []load
	var current *engineCase
	flush := func() {
		if current != nil {
			emit(enc, current)
			evaluations++
			current = nil
		}
	}
	for i := 177; i < 280; i++ {
		text := strings.TrimSpace(lines[i])
		if text == "" || strings.HasPrefix(text, "#") {
			continue
		}
		switch {
		case text == "clear":
			flush()
			fixture++
			loads = nil
		case text == "load":
		case strings.HasPrefix(text, "eval "):
			flush()
			text = strings.Split(text, " #")[0]
			current = &engineCase{Kind: "engine", Fixture: fixture, Loads: append([]load(nil), loads...), Expected: []series{}, SourceStart: i + 1, SourceEnd: i + 1}
			if m := instantRE.FindStringSubmatch(text); m != nil {
				current.Instant, current.Start, current.End, current.Query = true, number(m[1]), number(m[1]), m[2]
			} else if m := rangeRE.FindStringSubmatch(text); m != nil {
				current.Start, current.End, current.Step, current.Query = number(m[1]), number(m[2]), number(m[3]), m[4]
			} else {
				panic(text)
			}
		case strings.HasPrefix(text, "expect fail msg: "):
			current.Reject = strings.TrimPrefix(text, "expect fail msg: ")
			current.SourceEnd = i + 1
		case current != nil:
			m := resultRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
			if m == nil {
				panic(text)
			}
			labels := map[string]string{}
			if m[2] != "" {
				labels["app"] = m[2]
			}
			current.Expected = append(current.Expected, series{labels, strings.Fields(m[3])})
			current.SourceEnd = i + 1
		default:
			m := loadRE.FindStringSubmatch(text)
			if m == nil {
				panic(text)
			}
			l := load{App: m[1], Line: unquote(m[2]), Start: number(m[3]), Count: 1}
			if m[4] != "" {
				l.Every, l.Count = number(m[4]), number(m[5])
			}
			loads = append(loads, l)
		}
	}
	flush()
	if fixture != 2 || evaluations != 29 {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("unexpected fixture/evaluation counts: %d/%d", fixture, evaluations))
	}
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, "%d table queries, %d line decisions, %d engine evaluations\n", tables, decisions, evaluations)
}
